kv.memory.bd-label-autocommits: bd label add/remove auto-commits the whole .beads/ tree to git (seen 2026-10-20: a18d8afe, then pushed by accident). Never use bd label; and before any git push, check git log origin/main..HEAD for 'bd:' commits.
kv.memory.bd-update-notes-replaces-a-bea: bd update --notes REPLACES a bead's notes; use --append-notes to add. On 2026-10-18 --notes wiped earlier notes on 75 beads (mimid + crate-jmap); restored from .beads/events old_value history.
kv.memory.between-steps-cleanup: Mark 2026-10-22: sessions may run out of tokens mid-workflow, so after every batch/step leave clean resumable state: git worktree list shows only main (archive dirty worktree diffs to ~/Cache/worktree-archive-<date>/ before removing), merged worktree-* branches deleted, no stale agent in_progress claims (bd unclaim + note), decisions recorded on beads, and a CHECKPOINT note on the active epic naming pushed head, running run id, remaining bead ids.
kv.memory.build-cache-cleanup: Mark 2026-10-20: standing OK to clean build caches whenever no longer needed (shared ~/Cache/cargo-target, stale scratchpad target dirs marked by CACHEDIR.TAG). Never while a cargo build/workflow is running in it; do it between batches (e.g. rm -rf ~/Cache/cargo-target/debug after CI passes). Never delete non-cache work products.
kv.memory.constant-time-not-a-concern: Mark 2026-10-23: crate-jmap does not care about constant-time / timing side channels. RustSec timing-variability advisories (e.g. RUSTSEC-2026-0387 crypto-bigint) are resolved with a deny.toml ignore plus reason, not dependency upgrades. Other advisory classes still get fixed.
kv.memory.jmap-spec-operator-shoulds: Mark 2026-10-20: JMAP drafts cannot compel arbitrary JMAP operators to adopt strict ops policy (e.g. Agora's profile MUSTs): operator/deployment policy (witnesses, portability, method allow-lists, versionId recording) is SHOULD/MAY. Verifier rules already mandated by a referenced method spec (e.g. DIF did:webvh log verification) are not restated as our own MUSTs; defer to the reference ('as defined in DIF did:webvh v1.0').
kv.memory.local-gates-miss-github-ci: 2026-10-24: GitHub CI was red on main from 770d02b4 (2026-10-23) through 87284db6 while the local workflow CI gate was green: (1) the local gate set lacked the nightly public-api snapshot job (scripts/public-api.sh, nightly-2026-09-13) so 10 snapshots drifted; (2) local cargo deny passed with a stale advisory DB and missed RUSTSEC-2026-0386 (tokio). Before pushing, also check gh run list for the previous push, and run cargo deny fetch before cargo deny check.
kv.memory.publish-scene-vtc-graph: Mark 2026-10-20: specs fixed; Scene, VTC and Graph crates are to be publishable once created (flip publish=false after batch 8b, bead JMAP-6mry). Running cargo publish itself still needs Mark's explicit go.
kv.memory.spec-method-defaults: Decided by Mark 2026-10-19 (JMAP-ic0j.26): backend trait methods carrying spec semantics get NO default impl when a no-op default would put wrong data on the wire (e.g. availability, blob parsing); defaults are OK when the result is merely absent or the spec permits ignoring. Permission/policy hooks stay fail-open (JMAP-bghk).
kv.memory.spec-render: Render jmap-chat-spec drafts: KRAMDOWN_REFCACHEDIR=~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/.refcache ~/.local/share/gem/ruby/3.2.0/bin/kramdown-rfc <draft>.md > <scratch>/x.xml && xml2rfc --text -o <scratch>/x.txt <scratch>/x.xml (kramdown-rfc 1.7.43 user gem, installed 2026-10-21; gem bin dir not on PATH). Render-check every spec edit before commit.
kv.memory.workflow-ci-agent-foreground: Workflow CI-gate agents must run every command in the foreground: one agent armed Monitor and returned 'I'll wait' without running any gate (2026-10-18). Always check the CI result text has per-gate exit codes before trusting it.
kv.memory.workflow-verifier-worktree-pin: Workflow agent isolation:'worktree' can create the worktree at the run's starting HEAD, not the current HEAD (seen 2026-10-18: .16/.17 verified at abf6969a). For HEAD-pinned adversarial checks, have the verifier run git worktree add --detach at an explicitly resolved rev and report it; re-verify if head_sha != expected parent.
